ASIAN PAINTS (POLYMERS) PRIVATE LIMITED (CIN: U24292MH1945PLC004598)
Paint Manufacturing and Chemicals - Decorative paints, industrial coatings, automotive coatings, adhesives, polymers, and specialty chemicals
Headquarters: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Operations: 26 paint manufacturing facilities across 15 countries
Consolidated reporting scope covering all manufacturing facilities, subsidiaries, and international operations
Subsidiaries: Asian Paints Industrial Coatings, Berger International, SCIB Paints, Asian Paints PPG
Primary business focus: Decorative paints (70%), industrial coatings (20%), automotive coatings (10%)
Established: 1945. Public Company. Listed on BSE (500820) and NSE (ASIANPAINT). Market leader in Indian paints industry
Comprehensive sustainability policies: Environmental management, chemical safety, water conservation, waste reduction
Sustainability targets: 50% reduction in water consumption by 2030, 100% renewable energy by 2025, zero waste to landfill
Certifications: ISO 14001 (Environmental), ISO 45001 (Safety), GREENGUARD (Low emissions)
Member of: Indian Green Building Council, Responsible Care Initiative, UN Global Compact
Third-party assurance: EY for sustainability reporting, Bureau Veritas for environmental management
Material ESG issues: Chemical safety, air emissions, water usage, waste management, product sustainability
Reporting frameworks: GRI Standards, BRSR (SEBI), CDP Climate Change, TCFD
Board oversight: 12 directors including 6 independent directors. Sustainability Committee established
Chief Sustainability Officer reporting to MD&CEO. Sustainability integrated in business strategy
Anti-corruption policy covers all employees, suppliers, distributors. 100% training completion
Conflicts of interest policy for directors and key management personnel with annual declarations
GHG Emissions: 450,000 tonnes CO2e annually (Scope 1&2). 15% reduction achieved since 2020
Energy consumption: 2.1 million GJ annually. 35% from renewable sources (solar, wind)
Climate strategy: Science-based targets validated. Net-zero commitment by 2040
Environmental management: ISO 14001 certified facilities. Regular environmental audits
Renewable energy: 850 MW solar capacity installed. Wind power agreements for 200 MW
Water consumption: 1.2 million cubic meters annually. 25% reduction achieved through efficiency
Water recycling: 60% of water recycled and reused. Zero liquid discharge at 8 facilities
Water sources: Groundwater (40%), municipal supply (35%), surface water (25%)
Waste generation: 125,000 tonnes annually. 85% diverted from landfill
Hazardous waste: 15,000 tonnes annually. 100% disposed through authorized agencies
Circular economy: Paint can recycling program. Solvent recovery systems installed
Revenue: Rs. 24,500 crores (FY2023). Net profit: Rs. 2,250 crores
Local sourcing: 75% raw materials sourced locally. Support to 5,000+ suppliers
Total employees: 24,500 globally. India operations: 18,000 employees
Women employees: 18% of total workforce. Target: 25% by 2025
Diversity initiatives: Equal opportunity policy, women leadership development programs
Health & safety: Zero fatality target. Safety training for 100% employees
CSR spending: Rs. 45 crores annually (2% of average net profit)
Community programs: Education (40%), healthcare (30%), environment (30%)
Beneficiaries: 2.5 lakh people reached through CSR programs
